title: SearXNG: A free internet metasearch engine
summary: SearXNG is a free, privacy-focused open-source metasearch engine that aggregates search results from multiple providers while protecting user privacy. It's a modern fork of the SearX project with improved codebase and ongoing development.
problem_solved: Provides private, unbiased internet search without user tracking while aggregating results from multiple search engines.
why_valuable: It offers privacy protection and freedom from big tech surveillance while maintaining good search quality through result aggregation.
